page.title: Connectors
page.intro: Connect your advertising accounts. Leads from your ads arrive in My Leads automatically, with spend and cost per lead.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form leads into My Leads, daily spend and cost per lead, and lead quality sent back to LinkedIn (Conversions API).
catalog.notAvailable: Not set up on this server yet

banner.connected: LinkedIn connected. Leads are being fetched now - this page updates in a moment.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn is not set up on this server yet. An administrator must add the LinkedIn app's client ID and secret.
banner.expired: The LinkedIn connection has expired, so leads are not syncing. Reconnect to continue.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn requires you to sign in again by {{date}}. Reconnect before then to keep leads flowing.

connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sign in with the LinkedIn account that manages your ads. Leadrat only reads your ad accounts, Lead Gen Form leads and ad statistics, and sends conversions you switch on.
connect.need1: A role on the LinkedIn ad account (Viewer or higher).
connect.need2: A role on the linked company page (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager, Content Admin, Curator or Analyst) - LinkedIn requires it to share leads.
connect.need3: A phone number question on your Lead Gen Forms - leads without a phone number can't be added.

connection.title: Connection
connection.syncResult: Sync done: {{received}} received, {{created}} created, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} rejected.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect LinkedIn? Syncing stops and the access tokens are deleted. Leads, statistics and the activity log are kept.
connection.noPermission: You can view this page. Connecting and changing settings needs the "Manage Settings" permission.
connection.fetchHint: New leads are checked every few minutes and the last 7 days are re-checked every day, so nothing is missed. Use this for leads from before you connected, or to check a period again (up to 90 days at a time). Leads already in Leadrat are skipped.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}}: {{received}} found, {{created}} created, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} rejected, {{skipped}} already imported.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tell LinkedIn which of its leads became real prospects. When a LinkedIn lead reaches a status you choose below, Leadrat reports it to LinkedIn, so your campaign reports show lead quality and LinkedIn can find more people like your best leads. Only the LinkedIn lead ID and a one-way hash of the email are sent.
capi.created: Conversion created on LinkedIn and mapped.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Everything between Leadrat and LinkedIn: connections, every sync, every lead and what happened to it, conversions and errors.
